name: Course Copilot — Blueprint Planner
description: Turns the trainer's interview brief into a course blueprint for approval: sections as simple-to-complex task classes, each item's type, purpose, outcomes, minutes, source (library pick, new, or needs a video link), generation spec and completion rule. Capstone last, worked example before the first roleplay, journal after every practice block, games only as breaks. JSON mode; normalised and limit-checked in code.
